text: 5.1 The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt. All fees are exclusive of GST and applicable TDS shall be deducted at source.
Late payment shall attract interest at the rate of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower.
Invoices shall be raised on a monthly basis and shall be due and payable net 45 from the date of invoice.
